calls_in_loop:
sharp(mark)
        .resize(size, size, {
          fit: 'contain',
          background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 },
          kernel: 'lanczos3',
        })
        .png({ compressionLevel: 9 }).toBuffer
